owner_and_capability: Document Rendering — plan export capability with consumer-owned ports; birthday HTTP adapter; File Storage object-store adapter
atomic_cutover: The public plan export capability with its legacy adapter replaces services/planexport for the timetable Betreuungsplan route, the Workforce shift-planning Dienstplan route and the legacy service factory in one change; api/birthdays becomes modules/birthdays/http and api/common/documents becomes the File Storage object-store adapter modules/filestorage/documents with their callers switched in the same change. The old packages are deleted; no data ownership changes. The generic file-metadata repository and model keep their five remaining keys: their tables belong to File Storage (#2707) and cannot move without that owner's cutover.
tests: 63 rendering cases ported unchanged onto plain port records; adapter translation, nil-row, missing-person, error and malformed-day tests; two-tenant RLS over users.staff, facilities.rooms, activities.groups, schedule.activity_instances, schedule.instance_staff, schedule.instance_students, schedule.staff_shifts, schedule.shift_types, schedule.planning_tracks and schedule.closing_days with a real-source Betreuungsplan per school; retained routed birthday, timetable export, shift-planning export, student document and file store tests.

runtime_evidence.source: docs/runtime-checkpoints/plan-export-2706.md with candidate and baseline raw JSON, the baseline harness source and the EXPLAIN plans
runtime_evidence.workload: Local isolated PostgreSQL 17.11; baseline fixed at 939126a901186f7bbaeb984fee5ba7b10771a329; empty week, one week with 20 blocks, four weeks with 80 blocks as document, and the same four weeks as PDF; five warmups and 30 samples each, concurrency 1, real instance/staff/room sources, fixture-backed staff names, optional sources unbound.
runtime_evidence.thresholds: No new SLO. Compare local same-workload baseline, not staging/production parity. HTTP latency and the Dienstplan overview path excluded.
runtime_evidence.query_count: Both readers: 5 statements for the empty week, 7 for every non-empty scenario including commit (three transaction-scope statements plus the block, instance-staff and room reads); 42 and 162 driver-reported rows for 20 and 80 blocks; 0 DML.
runtime_evidence.errors: Zero unexpected errors, pool waits, deadlocks or observed lock waiters in both readers. No projection cache.
runtime_evidence.failure: A failing block or instance-staff read fails the export with the stable wrapped error; failing optional reads cost the detail and are logged; malformed request days are refused with ErrInvalidParams before any read; the handlers keep their 400/403/500 mapping.
runtime_evidence.rollback: The capability persists nothing; measured DML rows zero. Revert the factory, timetable, shift-planning and root wiring to restore the retained packages without data migration.
runtime_evidence.smoke: Real renderer emits PDF; the routed timetable, shift-planning and birthday tests run the production routers with JWT/permission/tenant middleware; the RLS test uses the real instance and instance-staff repositories and the public Facilities facade.

rollback_and_cleanup: Revert consumer wiring as a whole. The capability owns no authoritative state and no document metadata is persisted by the export paths. Delete the compatibility adapter with the last retained schedule source once Timetable & Activities and Workforce expose the plan reads publicly. No deployment or staging/production requests.
exit_criterion: One public capability serves both plan exports with unchanged document, filename and authorization contracts; the birthday and object-store adapters serve unchanged routes; 28 of the 33 listed keys plus five caller keys absent, legacy 1614 from 1647, composition 796 unchanged, ownership and policy epoch preserved; the five File Storage keys remain tracked under this issue until #2707.
